decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers build directly on the firm's existing heat-exchanger design, manufacturing and application knowledge, so with industry growth and strong absorptive capacity from engineering and service feedback the firm is more likely to refine and integrate this offering than withdraw it.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes are very closely related to the firm's core technological base and can be improved through its own know-how and learning from installed equipment, making continued commercialization more likely than exit despite limited recent website evidence.
